descriptionChirho: The proper geographical name for the northern region of Israel, known as Galilee (Hebrew גָּלִיל). All three sense clusters represent identical referents differing only in prepositional and article prefixes: 'in the Galilee' (eng in-the-Galilee, spa en-Galilea, arb فِي الْجَلِيلِ, kor 갈릴리에서, swa katika Galilaya), 'the Galilee' as direct object or genitive (eng the-Galilah, spa la-Galilea, hin गलील-के, arb الـجَلِيلِ), and the bare construct form 'Galilee of' (eng Galilee-of, spa Galil-de, hin गलील, kor 갈릴리, swa Galilaya). These are purely grammatical inflections of a single proper noun.
